_comment: Haus network residences, seeded from the public haus.fund site (read Aug 2026) plus our own planning notes. Only facts we have. start_date_precision: 'day' = exact date published, 'month' = month only, null = active with no start date given. Addresses are intentionally absent where not public.

nodes.name: Punk Haus
nodes.description: Flagship fundraising and cohort residence; Cohort 3 home. Communal cohort housing tied to the San Francisco ecosystem.
nodes.planning_note: Planning call Aug 20: the cohort residence is expected to be the Fitzgerald (620 Post St) from Sept 27, two floors, with the whole building as next year's aim. That deal was 'being signed' on Aug 20; our data does not confirm signature.
nodes.source: haus.fund (Aug 2026); Ria <> Elliot planning call Aug 20 2026

nodes.name: Fem Haus
nodes.planning_note: Planning call Aug 20: 2550 Van Ness (with Minerva University) is being worked for the femme house or safe house; ~10 to 12 women, kitchen required.

nodes.name: Alum Haus
nodes.description: Alumni house: extended stays and the ongoing founder network. Not a Cohort 3 intake house.
nodes.planning_note: Planning call Aug 20: alum house operational Sept 1 2026.

nodes.name: Safe Haus
nodes.description: Biosecurity / biodefense residence. Site says Sept 2026; no exact date published.
nodes.planning_note: 2550 Van Ness is a candidate for either the femme house or the safe house (Aug 20 call).

nodes.name: Cell Haus
nodes.description: Cell and gene therapy node in Kobe. Site says Sept 2026.
